name: Armor of Agathys

source.note: Not in the free 2024 Basic Rules; written from knowledge of the 2024 PHB and cross-checked against aidedd.org's 2024 entry. Level, school, classes, casting time, range, components, duration and Concentration match the D&D Beyond 2024 spell list.

upcast.text: The Cold damage dealt to attackers also rises by 5 for each slot level above 1.

summary: Gain 5 Temporary Hit Points; while they last, creatures that hit you in melee take 5 Cold damage.
text: A coat of magical frost covers you. You gain 5 Temporary Hit Points. Until the spell ends, any creature that hits you with a melee attack roll takes 5 Cold damage. The spell ends early once you have no Temporary Hit Points left. Lasts 1 hour. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the Temporary Hit Points and the Cold damage each rise by 5 for each slot level above 1.
